confirmed.title: A page wrapped in one <form> (ASP.NET WebForms) moves its Add to cart, Subscribe and other submit buttons into Sift's search bar, out of their own forms
confirmed.evidence: Fixture /home/nico/projects/sift/research/fixtures/r12rx-aspnet.html (http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/r12rx-aspnet.html) wraps the whole page in one form, as ASP.NET WebForms does. It has a header search box with a 'Search' submit, a product with Quantity and <input type=submit> 'Add to cart' and 'Add to wish list', and a newsletter Email field with 'Subscribe'. Harness: search more=[Add to cart, Add to wish list, Subscribe], and the content shows 'form: fields=[number:Quantity] actions=[]' and 'form: fields=[email:Email] actions=[]'. r10m kept 'actions=[Add to cart; Add to wish list]' and 'actions=[Subscribe]'. The real extension (port 9468, shot research/shots/r12rx-aspnet.png in sift-test-8) shows the top bar as 'Search | Add to cart | Add to wish list | Subscribe | Menu | My account'. The search box is squeezed to about 40 px, so a query cannot be read. The product and the newsletter form have no button where they are. This was added in round 11 for MoinMoin's Titles/Text (F1101).
confirmed.repro: cd /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12x && bun run.ts r12.js,r10m.js $PWD/fx/aspnet.html 1 --as http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/zz-aspnet.html ; or SIFT_PORT=9468 SIFT_TAB=R1-extractor bun scripts/visit.ts http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/r12rx-aspnet.html r12rx-aspnet
confirmed.suspectedCause: `more` takes every visible submit with an explicit type in pick.form. When that form is the whole page, the search box's 'form' holds every button of the page. Up to 3 of them are marked used and moved to the bar. Limit it to submits that share the search box's own container (for example the nearest ancestor that holds the box and btn and no other text field), or skip it when the form holds other fields or more than a few controls.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, real regression. I rate it high to medium. Harness with a bundle I built from the current src, on fx/r12rx-aspnet.html: 'search: Search products btn=Search more=[Add to cart, Add to wish list, Subscribe]'. The content forms are 'fields=[number:Quantity] actions=[]' and 'fields=[email:Email] actions=[]'. r10m keeps 'actions=[Add to cart; Add to wish list]' and 'actions=[Subscribe]'. In the real extension (port 9468), the top bar is Search box | Search | Add to cart | Add to wish list | Subscribe | Menu | My account. The search input is 50 px wide, so its placeholder and any query are unreadable (shot research/shots/sk12-aspnet.png). The product and the newsletter have no buttons in the content. The cause is as stated: generic.ts:6619 `more` takes every visible submit with an explicit type in pick.form, and here that form is the whole page. I found no live or snapshot page that hits it (no __VIEWSTATE among the snapshots). The pattern is standard for ASP.NET WebForms and JSF pages, though. I did not click the moved buttons, because the hard rules forbid posting forms.
confirmed.fix: src/content/extract/generic.ts findSearch, the `more` filter (line 6619): take only the extra submits that sit inside the smallest ancestor holding both pick and btn (here <header>), with no other visible text field in that ancestor. Or skip `more` when pick.form holds other visible inputs, selects or textareas besides the box. MoinMoin's search form (F1101) still passes either test.

confirmed.title: Pricing cells that two plans share are dropped at narrow widths and zoom when the comparison row scrolls sideways (new offscreen rule in stripCopies)
confirmed.evidence: Fixture /home/nico/projects/sift/research/fixtures/r12rx-plans.html is a div-based comparison table in an overflow-x:auto box. The Offline row says 'Recents and Favorites auto-download for offline use.' for Plus, Business and Enterprise. At 1280 px all 3 cells show. At 640 px (200% zoom on a 1280 px laptop) only the Plus cell shows, so Business and Enterprise look as if they lack offline use. This was checked in the real extension (port 9468, viewport 640) and in the harness. With marqueeCopies off (r11nomq) all 3 show at 640 px. The later cells are past the window's right edge, so offscreen(c) counts them as marquee copies. I could not find a live page that hits it: notion.com/pricing switches layout at 640 px, and github, linear, figma and slack pricing were unaffected. The snapshots plus live BBC, The Verge and Infobae lose nothing to this rule at 640 px.
confirmed.repro: cd /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12x && bun run.ts r12.js,r11nomq.js $PWD/fx/plans.html 1 --as http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/zz-plans.html --width 640 | grep -n '^===\|Recents'  (r12: 1, nomq: 3; with --width 1280 both 3)
confirmed.suspectedCause: offscreen(c) treats any later twin past the window edge as a scrolling copy, including cells in a horizontally scrolled table or row. Require an animated or transformed strip (a CSS animation or transform on the box), or a run of copies, before the offscreen test counts.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, medium. On fx/r12rx-plans.html, at width 640 the current bundle shows 'Recents and Favorites auto-download for offline use.' once. r11nomq and r10m show it 3 times. At 1280 all three bundles show it 3 times. The real extension (port 9468, viewport 640) gives a count of 1 in Sift's main, and 3 at 1280. The cause is offscreen() in stripCopies (generic.ts:3994): at 640 px the Business and Enterprise cells start past innerWidth inside the overflow-x:auto row, so they count as marquee copies. This contradicts stripCopies' own comment ('a pricing cell that two plans share' stays). It is the same notion-style case as F1131, now tied to zoom or width. Caveats: only a fixture shows it, and Sift already flattens this div table into paragraphs without plan names. Still, how many plans include offline use now changes with zoom.
confirmed.fix: src/content/extract/generic.ts stripCopies offscreen(): do not count a copy as offscreen when an ancestor within a few levels scrolls sideways for the user (computed overflow-x auto or scroll). Or require the box to be animated or transformed (getAnimations().length, or a non-none transform on the strip) before the offscreen test counts.

confirmed.title: Payment options told apart only by a brand logo now read the same: 'Pay in 4 interest-free payments' twice (logos over 32 px dropped from labels)
confirmed.evidence: Fixture /home/nico/projects/sift/research/fixtures/r12rx-paylogos.html has radios ' Pay in 4 interest-free payments' and ' Pay in 4 interest-free payments'. The round 11 base (r11.js) labeled them 'Afterpay Pay in 4…' and 'Klarna Pay in 4…'. Now both are 'Pay in 4 interest-free payments'. The real extension (shot research/shots/r12rx-paylogos.png in sift-test-8) shows two identical radios under 'Choose how to pay', so the user cannot tell which provider they pick. A screen reader on the original reads 'Afterpay Pay in 4…'. r10m also lacked the brand, so this undoes what F1010's change gave and is not new versus round 10.
confirmed.repro: cd /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12x && bun run.ts r12b.js,r11.js,r10m.js $PWD/fx/paylogos.html 1 --as http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/zz-paylogos.html | grep form
confirmed.suspectedCause: F1132's fix rejects every img wider or taller than 32 px. A logo-sized picture (about 24-48 px tall, under about 120 px wide) whose alt the label's words do not say still names the option. Reject only photo-sized pictures, or keep the alt when it is not in the text and the label would otherwise match a sibling option's label.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, medium at the low end. On fx/r12rx-paylogos.html the current bundle gives 'radio:Pay in 4 interest-free payments' twice. r11.js gives 'Afterpay Pay in 4…' and 'Klarna Pay in 4…', and r10m gives the identical pair. The real extension renders two identical radios, 'Pay in 4 interest-free payments', with no logo and no aria-label, so the payment provider cannot be told apart. Cause: dom.ts:701 rejects any img over 32 px in either dimension, so the 72x24 and 60x24 logos lose their alt. It is not new versus round 10. It only undoes what round 11 briefly gave. It is narrow, but it sits on a payment step.
confirmed.fix: src/content/dom.ts labelWords adds(): test mainly the height. Keep a picture up to about 40 px tall and about 160 px wide (a logo or badge), and reject square photos such as F1132's 80x80 gift box. pictureAdds(name, t) already drops alts the words say, so 'Red Red' stays fixed.

confirmed.title:
The date check is still quadratic when many dated lines sit directly in one element ('
'-separated references): extraction goes from 0.2 s to 6-9 s
confirmed.evidence:
The page is an article with meta article:published_time 2021-03-15 (not shown on the page), 30 paragraphs, and a References

of 3000 '
'-separated entries with years. Bundle built from the current src with a flag that skips the byline meta check, on the same page: check on 9400/5821/6076 ms, check off 225/177/142 ms; r10m 332/287/155 ms. At 1000 entries the check adds about 400 ms per pass, at 300 entries about 100 ms. In the extension (port 9468), firstpaint.ts on fx/r12rx-brrefs.html gives original and Sift both at 2696 ms and 4627 ms. fx/r12rx-brrefs-nodate.html, the same page without the meta tag, gives 627 ms and 683 ms. This repeats on every re-extraction.
confirmed.repro: cd /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12x && bun runp.ts p.js fx/brrefs.html http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/zz-brrefs.html 3 1  (flag=0 is the current code, flag=1 skips the meta-date check); extension: SIFT_PORT=9468 SIFT_TAB=R1-extractor bun scripts/firstpaint.ts http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/r12rx-brrefs.html 'article p' 2
confirmed.suspectedCause: F1136's fix bounded only the parent's parent. When p.parentElement is large, box = p, and p.textContent (the whole 180 KB paragraph) is rebuilt and searched for each of its 3000 dated text nodes. Test the joined text only when tlen(p) is small too, else test the node's own text plus its neighbors, or cache per box.
confirmed.verdict:
Confirmed, but narrow (low to medium). With fx/r12rx-brrefs.html (3000
-separated dated entries in one

, a meta date the page does not show), my current-src bundle took 4176/3775/4718 ms. r10m took 230/104/109 ms. A patched copy of src took 227/151/122 ms with the same outline; it skips box.textContent when box === p and tlen(p) >= 200. The nodate variant takes about 0.1-0.2 s in every bundle. The real extension's firstpaint gives 4741/4630/2941 ms, against 428/448/615 ms without the meta tag. The cost scales quadratically: at 300 entries it adds only 10-15 ms, and at 1000 about 150 ms. So it bites only with roughly 1000 or more dated text nodes directly in one element, on a page whose meta date the regex does not find before the list. The cause is as stated at generic.ts:7624-7625.
confirmed.fix: src/content/extract/generic.ts pageShowsDate: use box.textContent only when the box is small. For example, `if (re.test(s) || ((box !== p || tlen(p) < 200) && re.test(box.textContent ?? ""))) return "this";`. Or test the node's text joined with its sibling text nodes.

confirmed.title: YouTube comments: an opened thread has no 'Hide replies' in Sift (the threaded layout's #less-replies-sub-thread is not read)
confirmed.evidence: Real extension, live watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ: I opened Comments and clicked '3 replies' on the first thread. The 3 replies appear nested in Sift, so the new per-thread cache refreshed correctly. Sift's buttons matching /hide|repl/ are then only the other threads' 'N replies'. On the original, the visible collapse control is button < yt-button-shape < ytd-button-renderer#less-replies-sub-thread < div < yt-sub-thread (checkVisibility true). The '#less-replies button' that the selector reads is the hidden one. A reader who opens a thread of 900+ replies cannot fold it again. Not new in round 11: the selector was not changed.
confirmed.repro: SIFT_PORT=9468 SIFT_TAB=R1-extractor bun scripts/act.ts goto:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ wait:9000 click:Comments wait:6000 'click:3 replies' wait:5000 "eval:[...document.querySelector('sift-root').shadowRoot.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.innerText.trim()).filter(t=>/hide/i.test(t)).length" -> 0, while the original thread has a visible 'Hide replies' (#less-replies-sub-thread).
confirmed.suspectedCause: The selector list has #more-replies-sub-thread but not #less-replies-sub-thread. Add it.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed twice on live youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ in the real extension, medium at the low end. After I opened the first thread ('11 replies'), Sift showed 'Show more replies' and no control matching hide, less or collapse, by text or aria-label. That button sits inside the thread's ytd-comment-replies-renderer, and mine() is true for it. So adding it to the selector at youtube.ts:915 would pick it up. It is not a round 11 regression.
confirmed.fix: src/content/adapters/youtube.ts repliesOf (line 915): add '#less-replies-sub-thread button' to the selector list.

confirmed.title: The Short version drops a sentence that differs from an earlier one by one word: the south district's boil-water notice, the evening dose, a recipe step, a second senator's vote
confirmed.where: src/background/text.ts:946-956 (dropRepeats nearOf), :945 and :972 (prose 'seen' is never reset at a heading); called from src/background/index.ts:896 (checked)
confirmed.evidence: In Chrome 9469 with my mock (fx repeats.html), the model's answer had both 'Residents of the north district must boil their tap water.' and 'Residents of the south district must boil their tap water.' The Short version shows only the north line. The south paragraph is not put back, and the page gives no sign that anything is missing. Offline (r12ai9/repeats.ts, repeats2.ts), dropRepeats also drops '- Take one tablet in the evening with water.' after the morning line, and '2. Add 200 g of sugar and mix well.' after the flour step. It drops 'Senator Jones voted for the bill on Tuesday.' after Smith, 'The museum is open on Sunday until late.' after Saturday, 'Children should take the vaccine…' after Adults, and 'The west line is closed this weekend…' after the east line. Across headings, fx sections.html lost the instruction under 'After using the toilet', because it repeated the one under 'Before cooking'. Offline, a section left empty this way loses its heading too.
confirmed.repro: bun /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12ai9/repeats.ts and repeats2.ts. In Chrome: run bun r12ai9/mock.ts (port 8889), then SIFT_PORT=9469 SIFT_TAB=R3-ai-background bun r12ai9/settings.ts mock, then bun r12ai9/watch.ts repeats.html 6. The Short version has no 'south district'.
confirmed.suspectedCause: nearOf treats two sentences of 6 to 19 words as a repeat when one word is swapped (max = floor(len/10) || 1). Only numbers and negations are protected, so names, places, days, 'morning/evening', 'adults/children' and 'flour/sugar' are not. Prose sentences are compared across the whole text, including other sections. Lead: drop only exact repeats after normalizing. Or drop a near repeat only when the differing words are common function words. Keep the prose memory per heading section.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, high, regression (dropRepeats is new in the round 11 diff). In Chrome 9469 with my copy of the mock, repeats.html gave 'Residents of the north district must boil their tap water.' but no south district line, on the first visit (1 call) and on the cached revisit (0 calls). The original page has the south paragraph, and nothing in Sift's view shows that anything is missing. sections.html lost 'Wash your hands…' under 'After using the toilet', so that heading was followed by an unrelated line. Offline, dropRepeats drops the south district, Senator Jones, Sunday, Children, the west line, '2. Add 200 g of sugar…' and '- Take one tablet in the evening…'. The 'Platform 4/5' pair is kept only because its numbers differ. Cause confirmed in nearOf: max = floor(len/10) || 1, so one swapped content word in a sentence of 6 to 19 words counts as a repeat. Only negations and digits are protected.
confirmed.fix: src/background/text.ts dropRepeats: drop only exact repeats after normalizing. If near repeats stay, allow the differing words to be function words only, never names, places, days, times of day or nouns. Reset `prose` and `seen` at each heading line, so a section never loses its only sentence.

confirmed.title: The speaker check now drops a correctly attributed quote when the paragraph names an organization before a 'she said' quote: 'Maria Lopez said “we will strike…”' disappears
confirmed.where: src/background/text.ts:754-760 (speakerNear pronoun branch, new in the F1117 fix) and :777-785 (namesPerson counts any two capitalized words, such as 'European Union' or 'Ford Motor Company')
confirmed.evidence: In Chrome 9469 with the mock (fx strike3.html), the source paragraph is 'Union leader Maria Lopez spoke to workers outside the plant on Friday. The European Union opened an inquiry into the sale of the plant last week. “We will strike if a single job goes,” she said.' The model wrote 'Maria Lopez said “we will strike if a single job goes”.' The Short version drops that sentence, and the article's headline point (the strike threat) is gone. Offline (r12ai9/spk.ts), unsupported() returns 'speaker' for it, and also when the middle sentence is 'Ford Motor Company bought the plant in 2019.' The same quote is kept when the middle sentence names no two-word name. In round 10 the pronoun branch accepted Lopez, who is named in the same section.
confirmed.repro: bun /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12ai9/spk.ts prints 'speaker' for cases 1 and 2. In Chrome with the mock: bun r12ai9/watch.ts strike3.html 6. No Lopez line.
confirmed.suspectedCause: For a pronoun quote, any namesPerson() match after the speaker's mention rejects the speaker. namesPerson accepts any run of two or more capitalized words that does not follow 'in/from/…', so organizations, products and places count as people. Lead: count only names with a person cue (a role word, or a name the source ties to a speech verb elsewhere). Or ignore runs that start with 'The'.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, medium, regression (namesPerson and the para check are new in round 11). In Chrome with the mock, strike3.html's Short version dropped 'Union leader Maria Lopez said “we will strike if a single job goes”.' on the first visit and on the cached revisit. In the source, 'she' clearly refers to Lopez. Offline, the reporter's spk.ts gives 'speaker' for 'The European Union' and 'Ford Motor Company'. My own cases also give 'speaker' for 'Real Madrid lost…' before a quote by Carlo Ancelotti, and for 'The White House has not commented' before a quote by Senator Cantwell. Without that sentence the same quote is kept, and the F1117 case (John Smith between the speaker and the quote) is still rejected correctly. Common news organizations, clubs and institutions therefore block correctly attributed 'he/she said' quotes.
confirmed.fix: src/background/text.ts namesPerson: skip capitalized runs that start with 'The'. Count a two-word name only when it looks like a person: it has a role word before it, it is tied to a speech verb elsewhere in the source, or it is not a known organization pattern (Union, House, Company, Madrid…). Simplest: in the speakerNear pronoun branch, reject only when the later name is itself the subject of a speech verb or carries a ROLES word.

confirmed.title: Numbers in a Short version are no longer checked in any language but six: a Russian, Japanese or Dutch Short version can state a number the article does not
confirmed.where: src/background/text.ts:814 and :830 (unsupported returns '' when lang is not en/es/pt/fr/de/it, or is ''); src/background/index.ts:896 passes want
confirmed.evidence: Offline (r12ai9/nums.ts). The Russian source has 12 people injured and 40 million rubles. The rewrite 'При пожаре в Казани пострадали 21 человек. Ущерб — 400 млн рублей.' is kept whole with lang 'ru'. Without a lang (the round 10 path) it was dropped. In Japanese, the source has 3 workers and 12 fire engines, and a rewrite with 8 and 20 is kept. In Dutch, the source has 7 injured and 2 million euros, and 70 and 20 million are kept. The same happens when proseLang returns '' (Serbian, Norwegian, Malay, or Galician on a pt page).
confirmed.suspectedCause: The F1115 fix stops the number check for every language without a NUMBER_WORDS list. The check is right in most of these, because the source writes the number in digits. Lead: in such a language, drop a sentence only when the source has no word next to the same noun that could spell the number. Or put the source sentence back, as warningOf does. Or skip only the numbers 0 to 99 that a spelled-out word could stand for, and keep checking the rest.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, medium, regression from the F1115 fix (NUMBER_LANGS is new in round 11). Offline, nums.ts keeps the wrong Russian, Japanese and Dutch numbers when a lang is passed, and drops them without one (the old path). In Chrome with the mock, I made a Russian fixture (lang=ru: 12 injured, 40 million rubles). The mocked model answer said 21 and 400. The 'КРАТКАЯ ВЕРСИЯ' showed 'пострадали 21 человек' and 'Ущерб — 400 млн рублей' on two loads. The number check now guards only en/es/pt/fr/de/it, and pages where the language is ''. The trigger needs the model to misstate a number, but catching that is the whole point of the check.
confirmed.fix: src/background/text.ts unsupported: do not return '' for every language outside NUMBER_LANGS. Skip only the numbers the source could be spelling out: digits with no digit match in the source, when the source has unknown non-digit words in the same position. Or reuse the warningOf approach and put the source sentence back instead of keeping the rewrite. Keep checking numbers of three digits or more, and numbers the source writes in digits.

confirmed.title: A short line with a count or a time next to label words is still left out of the cache key and of the change hashes: '9 million viewers' becomes 12 million and the revisit silently drops the line (F1113 residue)
confirmed.where: src/shared/ticks.ts:50 (VOLATILE match returns true whatever else the line says) and :13 (LABEL has 'today at on the a de la las en'); used by src/background/text.ts:1114 (stableText) and src/content/short.ts:205 (counts)
confirmed.evidence: In Chrome 9469 with the mock, fx final.html first said 'The final drew 9 million viewers.' The first visit made 1 call, and the Short version had that line. The page then said 12 million. The revisit made 0 calls, and the Short version had no viewers line: the cached sentence failed the number check, and the changed paragraph was not shown in full. Offline, stableText is the same before and after for 'The firm sold 3 million shares.'→5, 'The proposal drew 1,200 comments.'→4,800, 'The fire started two hours ago.'→six, '- Volume: 1.2 million shares'→7.9, 'Today at 18:00'→'Today at 20:00' and 'Hoy a las 18:00'→'20:00'. onlyTicks returns true for each of them on the content side too, so a change during the visit is not caught either.
confirmed.repro: bun /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r12ai9/counts.ts. In Chrome with the mock: cp fx/finalA.html fx/final.html; bun r12ai9/watch.ts final.html 6; cp fx/finalB.html fx/final.html; bun r12ai9/watch.ts final.html 6 (condense=0, no viewers line).
confirmed.suspectedCause: onlyTicks treats any VOLATILE match as a tick line, even when other content words remain. LABEL also holds common words ('today', 'at', 'the', 'a', 'de', 'la', 'las', 'en'), so 'Today at 18:00' counts as a bare label. Lead: apply the label test to VOLATILE lines too: remove the VOLATILE match and require the rest to be labels. Keep 'today', 'at', the articles and the prepositions out of LABEL, or require a real label word ('updated', 'views').
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, medium (narrower than F1113, same family). In Chrome with the mock: finalA (9 million viewers) took 1 call and showed 'The final drew 9 million viewers.' After switching to finalB (12 million), the revisit took 0 calls, and the Short version had no viewers line at all, while the page says 12 million. Offline with the real stableText, the key is unchanged for 9→12 million viewers, 3→5 million shares, 1,200→4,800 comments, '- Volume: 1.2→7.9 million shares', 'Today at 18:00→20:00' and 'Hoy a las 18:00→20:00'. Doors 19:30→20:00 and 'death toll rose to 31→40' do change the key. onlyTicks returns true on any VOLATILE match, whatever else the line says. 'Today at …' is arguably a timestamp, and 'two hours ago' changes on its own, so those parts are debatable. The count lines are real content.
confirmed.fix: src/shared/ticks.ts onlyTicks: do not return true on a VOLATILE match alone. Remove the VOLATILE and tick matches, then require the remaining words to be labels. Take 'today', 'at', 'the', 'a', 'de', 'la', 'las', 'en' and other function words out of LABEL, or require at least one real label word. This fixes stableText (text.ts) and counts in src/content/short.ts together.

confirmed.title: A signed-in page whose sign-out is a button keeps its Short version and full text for 30 days, not 7. Sift also drops that Log out button from its view
confirmed.where: src/content/ai.ts:215-226 (privatePage looks only at top/nav labels and at logout links and forms); src/content/extract/generic.ts:6790 (TOP_LABEL has 'log ?in' but no 'log ?out' or 'sign ?out', so a header Log out button never reaches page.top or the Menu)
confirmed.evidence: In Chrome 9469 with the mock, fx account2.html is the same bank message with '<button type="button">Log out</button>' in the header instead of a logout link. After one visit, IndexedDB holds the Short version and the full text ('Dear Ben Ortiz, your account n…'), both with exp '30d (default)'. With the logout link (account.html), they are 7d. README.md:50 says results from signed-in pages are deleted after 7 days. In fx logout3.html (a header with nav links and a Log out button), Sift's view and its Menu list Example Bank, Accounts, Cards and Help, but no Log out. The reader cannot sign out from Sift. With an <a href=/logout> (logout4.html), the Menu shows it.
confirmed.repro: bun r12ai9/watch.ts account2.html 6; bun r12ai9/idb.ts | grep 'Ben Ortiz' (both entries 30d). Then: SIFT_PORT=9469 SIFT_TAB=R3-ai-background bun scripts/act.ts goto:http://127.0.0.1:8889/fx/logout3.html wait:2500 click:Menu wait:500 outline (no Log out).
confirmed.suspectedCause: privatePage's DOM query matches only a[href*=logout] and form[action*=logout]. The SIGN_OUT label test sees only page.top and page.nav, which never get a header button, because TOP_LABEL lacks sign-out words. Lead: add sign-out words to TOP_LABEL so the button stays usable, and let privatePage also test visible button and [role=button] text against SIGN_OUT.
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, medium, mainly for the lost control. In Chrome 9469, logout3.html (header nav plus <button>Log out</button>): Sift's view and its Menu listed 'Example Bank | Accounts | Cards | Help', with no Log out. I checked this twice. logout4.html (the same page with <a href=/logout>) shows Log out in the Menu. So a reader on a signed-in page cannot sign out from Sift's view. rejected.verdict: Rejected as a re-report of a round 10 rejection. The facts are true: in Chrome with the mock, account.html left a 7d entry {"text":"Dear Ana Ruiz, your account number ending in 4471…"}, and src/background/index.ts saves req.text under artKey. But research/round10/rejected.md already rejected exactly this report from the same agent ('the cache now also keeps the full page text of every condensed page (signed-in pages included)'), on the grounds that the impact is low. The data stays in the user's own browser profile with the same TTLs as the results, and nothing new has changed that assessment.

skeptic.verdict: Partly fixed, confirmed. The original case is fixed: in Chrome with the mock, doorsA→doorsB revisit made 1 new call and showed 'Doors open at 20:00.'
